# Built-in NgpCraft HLE BIOS

Copied from the desktop project `hle_bios/bios_hle.bin`. This is the clean-room 64 KiB firmware, not a console BIOS dump. The NgpCraft MIT license applies.

SHA-256: `11c2899850d56eff2ddcba4c0ef9ed7c5a8ea77f38fdcffc050c30295c6ac169`

The build verifies both its size and hash. Update this document and `vendor/cmake/embed_bios.cmake` together when refreshing the firmware. See `vendor/source-info.json` for the desktop revision and all vendored hashes.
